title: Notch call HUD
brief: While in a call (FaceTime, Zoom, Meet, WhatsApp...), show the call in the notch like the iPhone: live mic waveform from your voice, a green call timer, and a Call ended state on hang-up. No incoming calls in v1.

artboards.title: Call wings
artboards.tradeoff: Glanceable for the whole call like the iPhone Live Activity; widest compact shape for the whole call

artboards.title: Voice lip
artboards.tradeoff: Calm, notch barely grows, voice as a glowing line; less readable and does not name the app

artboards.title: Call card
artboards.tradeoff: Big card at start, end and on hover, wings between; most motion, covers windows briefly
